paired_bootstrap.estimand: median of paired per-block dense_ns / sparse_ns ratios
paired_bootstrap.interval: fixed-seed percentile bootstrap over timing-block pairs

claim_boundary: If all gates pass, this study establishes that one released positional GPT-2 attention program has an algebraically exact O(TD) on-device lowering, that the implementation is numerically equivalent to cached dense A@V on the frozen finite-input grid, that a native-pruning integration preserves the dense programmed attention-module output within tolerance, and that the lowered value mixer is faster at the reported CPU shapes. It does not establish a general compiler, bitwise equivalence, pretrained-model behavioral fidelity, end-to-end model speedup, allocator peak memory, cached decoding, backward performance, CUDA performance, or gains for other programs.

integration.dense_reference: stock eager GPT2Attention plus on-device cached A@V replacement at c_proj input
integration.sparse_path: save H9 V/O weights, use native prune_heads({9}), run stock 11-head eager attention, and add lerp(V0,V,0.01) @ O9
integration.supported_interface: eval-mode, unpadded, full-sequence self-attention; no cache, head mask, cross-attention, or attention-weight output

memory_estimand.dense: element_size * T^2 for one cached matrix shared across batch
memory_estimand.excludes: common input/output tensors and unmeasured allocator or kernel scratch
memory_estimand.sparse: zero additional tensor storage beyond the output because V[..., :1, :] is a view

timing.baseline_advantage: A, V, and V0 are resident before timing; dense matrix construction is excluded
timing.order: 30 paired blocks, alternating dense-first and sparse-first
timing.synchronization: synchronize immediately before and after every MPS block; CPU is eager

gates.integration_fidelity: every available device/dtype cell passes its frozen tolerance
gates.operator_fidelity: every available device/dtype/input cell is finite, structurally valid, and passes 8 * eps * max(1, max_abs(dense))
gates.positive_speed: at CPU float32 B=1,T=1024, paired median dense/sparse > 1.25 and bootstrap lower bound > 1.0

prior_observation.disclosure: Before this protocol was frozen, the public formula was inspected, unit tests and an unrecorded B=2,T=17 integration comparison were run, and two minimal smoke executions at CPU float32 B=1,T=64 were viewed while developing the runner. The full frozen fidelity grid, all other lengths, both batch-8 arms, and all 30-block timing distributions were not run or inspected. No result-dependent setting, gate, or stopping rule is permitted after this file is frozen.
prior_observation.status: development-smoke-informed benchmark confirmation, not pristine preregistration

title: Exact sparse lowering of a released GPT-2 programmatic attention head
